summary: Validation of unified review aggregation, newsletter subscriptions, 2FA TOTP, login lockout, SEO routes (robots/sitemaps/feed), CMS features, and Checkout/Fulfillment flows. Migration 0023_platform_batch.sql applied locally. All unit test suites green: core-services 158/158, public-api 66/66, admin-api 56/56. Typecheck gates pass: contract CT:0, storefront-ui STORE:0, admin-ui ADMINUI:0.

unifiedReviews.description: Product reviews migrated from cms_entries to product_reviews table with call-order aware test mocks, groupBy/limit aggregation, and GET endpoint 3-stage coverage.

newsletter.description: Newsletter subscription routes with admin UI tab and audit logging.

twoFactorAuth.description: TOTP-based 2FA with 10 recovery codes, signJWT optional expiresIn, 2FA login challenge.

loginLockout.description: Account lockout after 5 failed login attempts with 302/423 responses, failed_login_attempts and locked_until schema columns.

seoRoutes.description: SEO routes for robots.txt, sitemaps, and RSS feed.

adminRouteExpansions.description: New admin routes: auditLogs, reviews moderation, newsletter management, enhanced customers/orders/landingLeads/metrics/settings.

passwordReset.description: Forgot/reset password flow with IP+email rate limiting, 1h-scope JWT reset, token_version bump, referral attribution.

defects.title: Fulfillment fields SQLite parsing error in bash validation
defects.description: The fulfillment fields (tracking_number, carrier_name) updated successfully in the D1 command, but the validation script failed to grep the output correctly. Manual verification or better tooling is required.
defects.reproduction: Run qa/run_test_matrix.sh and observe FUL-P0-1 failure.

releaseConfidence.rationale: All unit test suites (core-services 158/158, public-api 66/66, admin-api 56/56) pass with no regressions. Typecheck gates pass across contract, storefront-ui, and admin-ui. New features (reviews unification, newsletter, 2FA, lockout, SEO, password reset, admin routes) are covered by unit tests and schema migrations applied locally. The residual risk relies on e2e/Playwright tests and production deployment of Cloudflare Queues for email/webhook delivery.
residualRisk: Stripe webhook concurrency and payload signature validation in production.
Storefront React Markdown rendering (cross-browser and XSS testing).
Cloudflare Queue consumer for Resend emails.
E2E Playwright test coverage for new 2FA and lockout flows.
